notes.title: Patch – April 29, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch – April 29, 2025
Fixed a crash caused by magic resource retrieval when constructing the Magic Zone.

notes.title: Patch on April 16, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch on April 16, 2025
Fixed an issue where sealing the Obelisk could cause errors in the Obelisk Search quest.

Due to the GameMaker engine version issue, I adjusted the version and reuploaded the game, fixing potential crashes caused by GMS version compatibility.

notes.title: Patch on April 12, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch on April 12, 2025
Fixed an issue with Cultural Policy Point bonuses.

notes.title: Patch – March 25, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch – March 25, 2025
Fixed an issue where the game could not proceed to the next turn after maxing out cultural policy points.

notes.title: Patch on March 23, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch on March 23, 2025
Fixed a bug where picking up equipment one frame before the start of combat would cause the equipment to disappear.

notes.title: Patch on March 22, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch on March 22, 2025
Deserts and swamps now function correctly. Additionally, the effect has been adjusted so that each desert or swamp tile increases the corresponding magic damage by +1%.
Judgment Day now functions correctly. In the game, Judgment Day will only target enemy troops and will not harm the player's own units.

notes.title: Patch on March 21, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch on March 21, 2025
Added resolution settings saving in the game options.
Note: Due to differences in player device parameters, if you encounter issues related to resolution or full screen, please provide your device details so I can fix these issues.

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 20, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - March 20, 2025

The Great Lighthouse can now be built correctly.

Fixed an issue with natural summons caused by the Chaotic Season landmark.

Fixed an issue with the display length of the trade route page.

Fixed an additional error caused by the Great Lighthouse in the morning, which prevented the Star Axis from being built correctly. The code here is not standardized enough, with too many if-else statements... Really sorry about that.

Adjusted the random mineral acquisition value in Mystical Garden to 1~10.

notes.title: Update for March 18, 2025
notes.notes:
Update for March 18, 2025

Researching the Calendar technology will now grant the Magic Well card.

Choosing the cultural policy "Standard Spellcraft" will grant the Magic Spring card.

The purpose of this change is to allow players to obtain the Magic Well faster and gain more mana during adventures.
Players who choose the magic path will receive double the mana bonus from the Magic Spring, making the effects more targeted.
This change requires starting a new game to take effect.

We apologize to players with existing game saves.

notes.title: Patch for March 17, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch for March 17, 2025

Fixed the crash error caused by auto-exploring sea areas.

Fixed the error where the Aarakocra Loft card could not drop correctly.

Changed the Magic Well card to be obtained after researching the Calendar technology.

notes.title: Patch for March 15, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch for March 15, 2025

Fixed the error in the old and new save formats for warship data.

Fixed the issue where the fleet page could not correctly display warship data.

Fixed the display error in the shipyard's description text.

Fixed the statistical data error caused by the repair of warship data.

notes.title: Update for March 12, 2025
notes.notes:
Update for March 12, 2025

Enhanced the soul-summoning ability of necromancy.

Expanded the range of summonable races. Now, all living species except for elementals, undead, golems, and machines can be summoned. This allows for the rapid summoning of a skeleton army.

Adjusted the rendering method to ensure that text in columns is properly aligned.

notes.title: Update on March 11, 2025
notes.notes:
Update on March 11, 2025

A huge thank you to Djin for reporting and Kayn for assisting, which helped me identify a critical bug.
Fixed an issue where the game could crash due to targeting errors when using magic attacks on multiple enemies.
My combat framework still needs further optimization, and I greatly appreciate the suggestions from all players.
I apologize for the negative impact these bugs have had on your gaming experience.
Wishing everyone a fun time playing!

Added UI data for city specialty statistics.

Monasteries and seminaries have reduced maintenance costs.

Optimized the random number formula for skill upgrades to ensure at least one existing skill is retained, reducing the probability of two undesirable skills appearing.

Fixed the text descriptions of some doctrines.

notes.title: Update for March 9, 2025
notes.notes:
Update for March 9, 2025

Fixed the parameter calculation error in the library.

Fixed the issue where the encyclopedia page could not display descriptions correctly.

Outposts now generate faith every turn, increasing strategic options in the early game.

Fixed the issue where some creeds did not take effect correctly.

Fixed the issue where the effects of magic springs were not displayed correctly.

Expanded the initial map size to better secure city-building locations.

Significantly reduced the impact of hero level on monster numbers.

Reduced the frequency and intensity of monster invasions and lowered the completion requirements for hunting quests.

Added building descriptions to the adventure map.

Land trade and maritime trade now correctly display their bonuses.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Due to an overnight update, a character was incorrectly written, which prevented the creation of new games. This issue has now been fixed. We sincerely apologize for the mistake.

By absorbing player feedback, we aim to avoid the situation where heroes become too weak by directly learning magic skills early in the game. Heroes will automatically acquire the most basic spells of a magic type during their adventures if they possess magic skills. This will enhance the hero's combat effectiveness. If a hero masters multiple magic skills, the highest-level magic skill will take precedence.

The game content is very rich, and many detailed numerical values need continuous refinement. Thank you for all the players' support!

notes.title: Patch Notes for March 6, 2025
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for March 6, 2025

Fixed a bug where the information of selected faith entries could not be displayed.

Significantly reduced animation intervals to address player feedback about slow combat speed. The overall combat speed has been increased. Since the combat system is inherently turn-based, the necessary backend calculations cannot be omitted, making it difficult to further improve speed at this time.

Added a resolution selection button.

Added explanations for some equipment and skill combinations.

Fixed an issue where equipment quality data could overflow.

Fixed an issue where morale and luck data could overflow.

Fixed potential data errors that could occur during equipment and troop type replacement.

Fixed text description errors for some equipment.

Some players have reported that the base drop rates for cards and equipment are too low. We have now increased the drop rates: the base drop rate for cards has been raised to 45% (+5%), and the base drop rate for equipment has been raised to 25% (+5%). We hope this will make your gaming journey smoother.
